failed_preliminary_attempt.cause: diagnostic recorder referenced the newly-added central_fd_vs_fp64_tangent key while constructing the same dict update; no projections were counted

classification: One bounded CPU-only independent FP64 sensitivity replay of exactly the 34 rows above 1e-6 in directional003. Rejected Newton 23 only; not a native noise-floor study, full local derivative qualification, coupled-system result, or physical validation.
limits: Only the listed subset of one rejected Newton 23 capture is replayed.
No physical transaction, native Metal, or accepted whole-system step is implied.
The smaller-step derivative comparisons do not change the 1e-6 threshold and are not all-nine-direction or full-material qualification.
All rows, branch changes, projection failures, and nonconverged endpoints are retained.

numerics.accepted_history: same captured FP32 accepted old-state widened exactly to FP64 for center and every endpoint; endpoint projected state is never reused as history; reference projector initializes each endpoint from that fixed accepted state and computes elastic trial state.
numerics.additional_endpoint_check: At every returned endpoint, independently recompute scaled residual, absolute Newton correction, and state-scaled Newton correction max(abs(delta_i)/max(abs(z_i),abs(old_i),1e-8)); residual and scaled-correction criteria are reported separately. Strict row comparisons are diagnostic only when both endpoints satisfy both checks and reported branch signature is unchanged.
numerics.branch_signature: Exact multiplier increment sign, yield-gap sign, and elastic_smoothed/plastic_smoothed complementarity selector. Bilinear hardening contributes the smooth factor 1+yield_gap+Hill_q; the independent evaluator exposes no separate hardening max/sign branch, so no such branch stability is claimed.
numerics.mp90_use: MP90-v2 is bound as an independent evaluator cross-check for overlapping selected rows (tet 457 and 1635); its own original three-point/ten-target outputs are not rerun or overwritten. It does not validate all 34 centers.
numerics.noise_floor: No native FP32 noise-floor estimate is made; decreasing-epsilon stability is not called a noise floor.
numerics.perturbation: F± = captured F_high32 + F_low32 + epsilon * dt32 * captured Fdot32, evaluated in independent FP64; epsilon = target Frobenius norm / ||dt*Fdot||. Actual realized FP64 endpoint directions and norms are recorded.
numerics.reference_projector: bilinear15_reference.py stock FP64 safeguarded projection, max 80, residual stop 2e-10 scaled.

selection.rule: exactly directional003 all_1728_row_metrics.csv rows whose central_fd_relative_error > 1e-6
